market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political figure from PSOL, a party that has never received more than ~1% in a presidential race. Historically, second place goes to candidates from major parties (PT, PL, PSDB). Santos has no realistic path to surpass Lula, Bolsonaro's successor, or other established national figures.
evidence_points: PSOL's best presidential result was Guilherme Boulos (2018) with 0.58% of votes.
In 2022, PSOL did not run its own candidate, endorsing Lula's coalition.
Second place in recent elections has required 30–40% of valid votes, far beyond any PSOL candidate's reach.
sources_consulted: Recent polling aggregate for 2026 election (implied top contenders)
